definitions.explanation: The order or sequence of actions to accomplish something.

examples.japanese: {手順|てじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To work according to the procedure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手順|てじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will explain the registration procedure.

examples.japanese: {手順|てじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えると→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you get the steps wrong, you will fail.

notes:
{手順|てじゅん} emphasizes the ordered sequence of steps needed to accomplish a task. It focuses on "what comes first, what comes next" rather than the method itself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手順|てじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to follow the proper steps
- {手順|てじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm the procedure
- {手順|てじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to get the steps wrong
- {手順|てじゅん}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: procedure manual
- {手順|てじゅん}⟦{通|どお}り→通り：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: according to procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: procedure involving paperwork or formalities (bureaucratic)
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method (broader, how to do something)
- ⟦{順序|じゅんじょ}→順序：05460_junjo⟧: order, sequence (more abstract)
- ⟦{段取|だんど}り→段取り：06629_dandori⟧: preparation and planning of steps (informal)

USAGE:
Commonly used in technical, workplace, and instructional contexts. {手順|てじゅん} implies that the order matters — skipping or rearranging steps leads to failure.
